q: The ε-hypothesis testing relative entropy D_h^ε(ρ||σ) is defined as the minimum of −log β over type-II error β, subject to type-I error α ≤ ε. Its relationship to the quantum relative entropy D(ρ||σ) in the i.i.d. limit is:
exp: Quantum Stein's lemma (Hiai-Petz 1991, Ogawa-Nagaoka 2000): D_h^ε(ρ^⊗n||σ^⊗n)/n → D(ρ||σ) for any fixed 0 < ε < 1. This gives an operational meaning to quantum relative entropy as the optimal error exponent in quantum hypothesis testing.
